confirmDeleteImport: Are you sure you want to delete this import configuration?
previewEmpty: No data found in this file.
confirmDeleteExport: Are you sure you want to delete this export configuration?
cancelJobConfirm: Stop this job? It will finish the row it's currently on, then stop — anything already imported/exported up to that point is kept.
wooConvertIntro: Converts a WooCommerce product-export CSV into the format this app's product import expects. The two formats don't line up field-for-field — review the result before importing, especially the category matches and any type warnings below.
wooConvertDropzoneLabel: Drag & drop your CSV here, or click to browse
wooConvertFileHelp: A .csv export from WooCommerce (Products > All Products > Export).
wooConvertFamilyCodeHelp: Applied to every converted row. Leave blank if unsure — products can be assigned a family later.
wooConvertCategoryHelp: This app's category tree uses different codes/names than a WooCommerce store. Categories that can't be automatically matched by name are listed in a downloadable report after conversion — fill in the codes there and upload it back here to apply them. Once applied, each mapping is remembered permanently, so future conversions won't need that file uploaded again.
wooConvertLocaleCaveat: Product name and description are stored without a specific language assigned, since this converter has no per-language mapping. Verify they display correctly before relying on them, or leave these unchecked and set names manually.
wooConvertResultSummary: Converted "{{file}}": {{count}} row(s) ready to import, {{skipped}} row(s) skipped (no SKU).
wooConvertNewBrandsHelp: These brand names didn't have a matching option yet, so a new one was created automatically for each. Review them under Attributes > Brand if you want to rename, merge, or reorder them.
wooConvertUnmatchedHelp: Some categories could not be matched automatically. Download the report, fill in pcatname/psubcatname/productgroupname for each row, then convert again with that file as the Category Mapping — those mappings are then saved permanently, so later conversions of the same store's data resolve them automatically.
wooConvertNextStep: Once you're satisfied with the result, use the converted CSV as the file for a Products import.
